build_scheduler_for_graph: build a Scheduler with a dataflow graph and GUROBI solver to optimize memory scheduling
run_compute_optimal_schedule: run ComputeOptimalSchedule on a Scheduler to find the optimal memory schedule for a graph
compute_asap_schedule: compute the ASAP schedule for all nodes in a dataflow graph given schedule constraints
compute_alap_schedule: compute the ALAP schedule for all nodes in a dataflow graph given max timesteps
compute_minimum_memory_required: compute the minimum memory required to run a graph and identify the bottleneck node
